location.site_description: Near East Tillman Road and Adams Center Road on the southwest side of Fort Wayne

status_as_of_cutoff: partial live; City of Fort Wayne says the first phase is operational and construction is ongoing, while Google says it broke ground in 2024 and continues to make progress. IDEM air-permit records identify Hatchworks LLC as owning/operating a stationary data center at 7510 Zodiac Way.

milestones.government_body: Indiana Economic Development Corporation / Governor of Indiana
milestones.result_status: Google announced a $2 billion Fort Wayne data center and broke ground near East Tillman Road and Adams Center Road.
Initial Part 70 construction/operating permit issued to Hatchworks LLC for a stationary data center at 7510 Zodiac Way.
City FAQ states the first phase of the Google data center is operational and construction is ongoing.

milestones.action_type: air permit modification approval reported by local media
milestones.result_status: IDEM approved additional emergency diesel generators; public IDEM draft record documents 174 main emergency generators plus ancillary units and 64 cooling towers.
Public notice opened hearing process for Project Zodiac Phase 3 wetland/water-quality impacts.

capacity_notes: No public source located states IT critical load or utility contract demand. IDEM draft permit materials and local reporting support emergency/backup generation scale only: Gen 1-174 are 3,019.30 kW each, plus ancillary generators/fire pumps; WPTA reports 179 diesel generators could generate 527.52 MW if operated.
owner: Google LLC; Hatchworks LLC is the permittee/local operating entity in IDEM records

contradictions.details: IDEM permit records use 7510 Zodiac Way, Fort Wayne, IN 46816; some media reports describe the site as 5801 Adams Center Road. The official IDEM address is used as the structured address, with the road-intersection description retained.
Public sources quantify emergency/backup generator output but do not verify IT critical load or utility contract demand; capacity_mw remains null.

history.note: Seed-only record refreshed with first-hand city, state, Google, and IDEM evidence.
